meta.name: manage-mounts
meta.description: Configure which host directories agent containers can access. View, add, or remove mount allowlist entries. Triggers on "mounts", "mount allowlist", "agent access to directories", "container mounts".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理容器可访问的主机目录挂载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要控制 agent 容器能访问哪些主机目录
copy.tagline_en: Manage which host directories agent containers can access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control which host directories agent containers can access

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 能让你查看、添加或删除“允许 agent 容器访问的主机目录”列表,并可为每个目录设置只读或读写权限。配置保存在 ~/.config/nanoclaw/mount-allowlist.json。
howto.when: 当你提到“mounts”、“挂载允许列表”等关键词,或要求查看/修改 agent 能访问的目录时触发。

say.text: 看看当前挂载允许列表里有哪些目录
say.note: Claude 会读出目录及各自的读写权限。

say.text: 把 /data 加进挂载允许列表,设为只读
say.note: Claude 会验证路径并写入配置。

say.text: 把 /home/user/projects 从挂载列表里删掉
say.note: Claude 会更新配置移除该目录。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude lets you view, add, or remove host directories that agent containers may access, and set each as read-only or read-write. The config is stored at ~/.config/nanoclaw/mount-allowlist.json.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "mounts", "mount allowlist", or similar keywords, or ask to view/change the directories agents can access.

say_en.text: Show me the current mount allowlist entries.
say_en.note: Claude lists the directories and their access modes.

say_en.text: Add /data to the allowlist as read-only.
say_en.note: Claude validates the path and updates the config.
Claude updates the config to drop that entry.
